USER, secure login — Valid password -> HttpOnly session; invalid -> generic 401 and throttle
ADMIN, invite teammate — Invite has role and expiry; reused token fails; invite visible in admin list
SALES, create lead — Valid input -> real persisted record + activity; invalid input -> field error
SALES, see only permitted leads — User B GET/PATCH User A private record -> 404, unchanged DB
SALES, convert lead — Conversion retains contact ID and linked deals; repeated conversion safe
SALES, manage deals — Update stage with expected version; stale request -> 409 no overwrite
MANAGER, approve proposal — Draft cannot publish without required internal approval
CLIENT, approve proposal — Only correct invited org may accept current, nonexpired version once
PM, convert won deal — Project/baseline created once, all related writes atomic
MEMBER, track task — Assigned member can update own permitted status, not project budget
PM, request change order — Scope/price/timing differences visible; accepted delta updates baseline
CLIENT, approve deliverable — Explicit decision with timestamp and version; wrong client denied
FINANCE, track payment — Partial amounts reconcile precisely; roles restricted; history retained
OWNER, inspect pipeline — KPI changes after database updates; date filters and permissions applied
USER, mobile workflows — All primary actions usable at 360px without horizontal page scrolling
USER, keyboard navigation — Focus visible, dialogs keyboard navigable, forms labeled, controls reachable
USER, accidental double-submit — Repeated transition returns same outcome, no duplicate project/invoice
ADMIN, offboard person — Deactivation invalidates sessions and blocks new access immediately
CLIENT, download file — Short-lived authenticated URL for published approved file only
USER, system errors — Recoverable, human-readable error with correlation ID, no stack/secrets
OWNER, export report — Export includes only permitted data; CSV spreadsheet injection neutralized
PM, see estimated margin — Shows input completeness and distinguishes estimate from actual cash
USER, AI suggestion — AI off by default; drafts don't change records; approval required
Deny by default for every route/service/repository query; fail closed when agency/ownership missing.
Test client-user A vs client-user B, salesperson A vs B, staff vs finance, unassigned vs assigned, disabled vs active accounts.
Use trusted password hashing implementation (Argon2id where feasible), policy against weak passwords and hashed reset/invite tokens.
No public registration; bootstrap is CLI-only, first-run guarded; never ship default admin credentials.
Session token at least 128 bits CSPRNG entropy, hash in DB, rotation, expiry/revocation and secure cookies.
CSRF mitigation on all state-changing authenticated requests, including forms and sensitive portal decisions.
Server-side Zod schemas, strict field whitelisting, content-length and request rate limits; paginate and cap exports.
CORS explicit allowed origins, no wildcard with credentials; HTTPS on production; HSTS after verified HTTPS.
Proper CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy and secure cache headers for sensitive pages.
Object-level and property-level authorization independent from UI visibility.
Tenant-ready `agency_id` with nested FK consistency; never rely on ID obscurity; actual multi-tenancy not enabled in v1.
File mime/content checks, allowed extension policy, size quotas, safe filenames, private encrypted storage and scanning/quarantine before publication.
All file downloads generated after live authorization decision, short expiry, correct content disposition; no untrusted same-origin HTML execution.
Use decimal-safe currency math, server validation and transactionally reconciled payments; no card or bank secrets stored.
Add optimistic locking and idempotency on proposal/client approval/change accept/project creation/invoice payment actions.
Store sensitive configuration in environment/secret manager, never repository, client bundle, screenshots or logs.
Append-only audit security events with time, actor, request ID, outcome, entity and redacted metadata; restricted access.
Alert/record suspicious login/reset/invite activity and repeated denial events without exposing PII.
Enforce safe outbound webhook architecture with SSRF tests and signed payloads.
Retention policy for PII, exports, audit logs, uploaded files and backups; authorized deletion/export handled with documented limitations.
SAST/dependency/secret/container scans run in CI; severity gating and documented exceptions; scanning not substitute for testing.
Restore drill and incident runbook documented; no “zero vulnerability” claims.
Use the relevant legal/privacy review before real client deployment. Do not assert regulatory compliance from this blueprint.
Email notifications never include confidential full proposal/client data by default; send links requiring auth.
Private aggregate reporting must prevent leakage of unassigned records through counts, searches, error differences and exports.
AI is an optional adapter disabled until OWNER opt-in; provider/API costs configurable.
Per-user and record-scope authorization happens **before** data retrieval and model call.
Minimize/redact sensitive data; display a data-use notice and prohibit credentials/tokens in prompts.
Prompt injection treated as an expected threat from notes, emails and documents; instructions inside source data are untrusted.
AI output is a DRAFT, never accepted/issued/sent or used to mutate a deal/invoice without explicit human review.
Tool execution disabled in v1; if added later, apply least privilege and per-operation approval.
Bound context, token cost, rate, timeouts, output schema and retries; show useful fallback when AI unavailable.
Log metadata/cost and consent, NOT raw secret prompts; configure retention policy; allow deletion.
No predictive scoring accuracy claims without labeled evaluation dataset and documented metrics.
Test cross-customer exfiltration and prompt injection with adversarial untrusted notes before enabling AI.
